1. Mount the phone above the board (a tripod or phone stand). The more straight-down the view, the better.

2. Drag the yellow dots onto the 4 outer corners of the board squares. Check the labels: a1 must be on White's left. Use Rotate a1 if needed.

3. Choose your colour and tap Start game with all pieces in place.

4. Play normally. Take your hand away after each move. ChessCam spots the move, and on your turn Stockfish says the best reply and draws it as an arrow.

5. If a move is missed or wrong, tap Undo, or tap the move's squares on the small board to enter it yourself. Re-sync tells the app the real board is correct as it is now.

Good light and no shadows moving across the board help a lot.
